A_spatial_separation_novel.question: Is spatial separation of drug delivery from CSF drainage novel?

B_selective_retention_novel.question: Is selective molecular retention in eShunt context novel?
B_selective_retention_novel.verdict: NOVEL — L4 (selective retention) not found in ANY of 15 charted patents

C_combination_obvious.question: Is the combination obvious even though neither reference individually has all limitations?
C_combination_obvious.motivation: SEARCH_INCOMPLETE — no passage found teaching motivation to combine spatial separation with selective retention in eShunt context
C_combination_obvious.reason_to_combine: The problem (drug loss to drainage) is recognized, but the SOLUTION (controlled separation) is not taught in prior art
C_combination_obvious.reasonable_expectation_of_success: A PHOSITA would NOT expect 327% improvement from 80mm shunt with 1.4 mL/min drainage — the separation distance is short relative to drug distribution. The magnitude is unexpected.
C_combination_obvious.technical_compatibility: COMPATIBLE — both mechanisms reduce drug loss to drainage; they operate on the same physical principle
C_combination_obvious.teaching_away: PARTIAL — rapid CSF turnover (~7h) might teach away from attempting drug residence in shunt, as conventional wisdom is that CSF drugs are quickly cleared
C_combination_obvious.unexpected_technical_result: YES — 327% improvement is much larger than PHOSITA would predict from 80mm separation. The model shows the effect is robust across 8 model formulations and 100 therapeutic parameter combinations.
C_combination_obvious.conclusion: 103 leans NON_OBVIOUS: (1) both L3 and L4 are individually novel (not found in 15 patents), (2) no motivation to combine found, (3) unexpected magnitude of effect. But UNCERTAIN — patent counsel opinion required.
C_combination_obvious.status: HYPOTHESIS — leans NON_OBVIOUS but not a legal conclusion
C_combination_obvious.critical_rule: Do NOT write 'no single reference has all 7 limitations, therefore non-obvious.' That proves only 102. 103 requires motivation + expectation + compatibility + teaching-away + unexpected result analysis.
